description: This file contains server-side logic for the ExamResult page of an online examination system. It handles displaying the user's exam result, updating the database with new total marks and exam count, and provides navigation controls such as home, profile, leaderboard, and logout.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult ASP.NET page, managing display and update of exam results.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. It retrieves session data, displays the user's exam mark, updates user info in the database with new total marks and exam count, calculates the average, and populates various UI elements with session data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the home button, redirecting the user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the profile button, redirecting to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the leaderboard button, redirecting to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the logout button, redirecting to the login page.
